prompts.system: You are a careful multiple-choice reasoner. Follow the requested review mode. Your visible response must contain only the two requested label tokens.
prompts.solve_template:
{item}

Solve the item from scratch. Return exactly two label tokens with no separator: first one answer label from {answer_labels}, then one confidence label from {confidence_labels}. Confidence labels 1 through 9 mean probabilities 0.1 through 0.9.

panel_highstakes.role: post-hoc breadth panel, declared 2026-09-08 after the primary results were recorded
panel_highstakes.selection_rule: seeded SHA-256 rank within subject after excluding every primary-panel item_id, then output ordered by subject and item_id
panel_highstakes.rationale: high-stakes subjects where a confidently wrong answer is the deployment risk; items disjoint from the primary panel

policy_cautious.role: post-hoc review-policy variant, declared 2026-09-08 after the primary results were recorded
policy_cautious.rationale: tightens both escalation thresholds by one confidence band relative to the primary workflow; prompt templates, labels, decoder, and panel machinery are unchanged
